content.text: No audit, inspection, or verification right binding Clear Capital appears anywhere in this agreement.

input.quote: Contractor shall bill Company as set forth in the relevant Statement of Work. Each invoice submitted by Contractor will provide supporting detail for the Services invoiced, including, to the extent applicable to a particular engagement, the dates of Services and hours worked at the applicable rate by Statement of Work.
input.rationale: Searches for "audit", "inspect", "verif", "records" and "access", plus a full read of the compensation (§ 3) and ownership/acceptance (§ 4) sections, show the Agreement grants RadialSpark no audit, inspection or verification right over Clear Capital's records, usage or systems. Compensation flows one way (Contractor invoices Company with supporting detail under § 3(b)), so there is no usage or underpayment verification right to constrain. The only access-related provision (§ 1, p0007) runs in our favor, requiring Contractor to comply with Company's system security policies. Absence of any audit right binding us exceeds the preferred position, so no redline is warranted.
